description: This is a source code file implementing a FastAPI web service for resume parsing and matching. It provides an endpoint to upload resumes in PDF or DOCX formats, extracts key candidate information (name, contact, skills, experience, education), and compares extracted keywords against a provided job description to compute a match score. The code includes utility functions for text extraction, section parsing, and keyword matching, as well as API route handlers and data models for requests and responses.

classes.name: ExtractedData
classes.description: Data model representing extracted candidate information such as name, contact, skills, experience, and education.

classes.name: MatchResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the match score, matched/missing keywords, summary, and extracted data.

attributes.name: matched_keywords
attributes.description: Keywords that appear in the resume

attributes.name: missing_keywords
attributes.description: Keywords from the job description that are missing in the resume

attributes.name: extracted
attributes.description: Extracted resume fields as an ExtractedData instance

methods.name: str _clean_text(text: str)
methods.description: Normalize whitespace and convert text to lowercase for matching.

methods.description: Extract raw text from a PDF byte stream using PyPDF2.

methods.name: str _extract_text_from_docx(file_bytes: bytes)

methods.name: str _extract_name(text: str)
methods.description: Heuristic to extract candidate's name from the text.

methods.name: str _extract_contact(text: str)

methods.name: str _extract_experience(text: str)

methods.name: str _extract_education(text: str)

methods.name: Tuple[float,List[str],List[str]] _compute_match(resume_text: str, jd_text: str)

methods.name: health_check()

methods.description: Main endpoint to upload a resume and compare against a job description, returning a detailed match report.
